parties.respondent_defendant: S.Sankar (died), S.Dayalan, S.Laxminarayanan, S.Baskaran, S.Prabakran, S.Jagannathan, S.Bhavani, S.Gajalaxmi, C.Vengamma, C.Mala Kondiah, C.Malayadri, P.Varamma, S.Saraswathi, S.Mahesh, S.Suresh

facts_of_case: Suit filed for partition by the appellants/plaintiffs was dismissed. The plaintiffs sought relief with allegations of marriage between T.E.Sivanesan Chettiar and the first plaintiff in 1948.

legal_principles.principle: The factum of marriage must be proved by sufficient evidence to establish the status of wife.
legal_principles.held: So long there is no proof or material to substantiate the fact that the first plaintiff was the legally wedded wife of Sivanesan Chettiar, she could not make any claim since she had no status of wife.
cited_cases: 100 L.W. 58 (SEERANGAMMAL (DIED) AND OTHERS V. E.B. VENKATASUBRAMANIAN AND OTHERS)

legal_principles.principle: A person claiming the status of wife must prove the factum of marriage to establish their claim.
legal_principles.held: The duty was cast upon the plaintiffs to prove the marriage; that so long there is no proof or material to substantiate the fact that the first plaintiff was the legally wedded wife of Sivanesan Chettiar, she could not make any claim since she had no status of wife.
cited_cases: 100 L.W. 58 (SEERANGAMMAL (DIED) AND OTHERS V. E.B. VENKATASUBRAMANIAN AND OTHERS)

outcome.result: Appeal preferred under Order XXXVI Rule (1) of O.S. Rules read with Clause 15 of Letters Patent against the judgment and decree dated 10.12.2001 made in C.S.No.616/87 was dismissed.

use_for_drafting: using Letters Patent for original appeals
